answer: Random beacon spot-checks with compute heartbeats stop bulk fakes. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% of identities; each must answer a challenge in 10 minutes and prove its heartbeat runs, or it is left out in the tundra, cut off. A replayed heartbeat freezes it for 20 epochs, and an opal seal marks only passers. Forging 100 identities costs 3,000 credits, all lost on failure, while one honest agent pays 30 once and keeps its island share undiluted.
